<Slide>
  <VStack w="1280" h="720" padding="44" gap="24" alignItems="stretch" backgroundColor="$surface">
    <VStack gap="6" padding="0 0 8 0" backgroundColor="$surfaceAlt" borderRadius="14" shadow.type="outer" shadow.blur="6" shadow.offset="2" shadow.color="000">
      <Text fontSize="14" color="$accentText" bold="true" letterSpacing="2">AUTOMATION</Text>
      <Text fontSize="36" color="$textMain" bold="true" lineHeight="1.15">Ads Automation Engine Designed for Quick Commerce</Text>
      <Text fontSize="18" color="$textMuted">AUTOMATION — Execution</Text>
    </VStack>
    <VStack grow="2" padding="24" gap="12" backgroundColor="$surfaceAlt" borderRadius="14" border.color="$border" border.width="1" shadow.type="outer" shadow.blur="6" shadow.offset="2" shadow.color="000">
      <Flow direction="horizontal" h="max" minH="200" nodeWidth="180" nodeHeight="56" nodeGap="64">
        <FlowNode id="input" shape="flowChartProcess" text="Input: Platform Data" color="$accentSoft" textColor="$textMain" />
        <FlowNode id="engine" shape="flowChartProcess" text="Decision Engine" color="$accentSoft" textColor="$textMain" />
        <FlowNode id="actions" shape="flowChartProcess" text="Bid Optimization Budget Reallocation Keyword Expansion Placement Optimization" color="$accentSoft" textColor="$textMain" />
        <FlowNode id="outcome" shape="flowChartTerminator" text="Business Outcome" color="$accentSoft" textColor="$textMain" />
        <FlowConnection from="input" to="engine" />
        <FlowConnection from="engine" to="actions" />
        <FlowConnection from="actions" to="outcome" />
      </Flow>
    </VStack>
    <VStack gap="14">
      <HStack gap="14" alignItems="stretch">
        <VStack w="32%" padding="18" gap="8" backgroundColor="$positiveSoft" borderRadius="14" border.color="$border" border.width="1" justifyContent="center">
          <Icon name="clock" size="24" color="$positive" alignSelf="start" />
          <Text fontSize="18" color="$positiveText" bold="true">Faster optimization cycles</Text>
        </VStack>
        <VStack w="32%" padding="18" gap="8" backgroundColor="$positiveSoft" borderRadius="14" border.color="$border" border.width="1" justifyContent="center">
          <Icon name="users" size="24" color="$positive" alignSelf="start" />
          <Text fontSize="18" color="$positiveText" bold="true">Reduced manual intervention</Text>
        </VStack>
        <VStack w="32%" padding="18" gap="8" backgroundColor="$positiveSoft" borderRadius="14" border.color="$border" border.width="1" justifyContent="center">
          <Icon name="trending-up" size="24" color="$positive" alignSelf="start" />
          <Text fontSize="18" color="$positiveText" bold="true">Improved ROAS</Text>
        </VStack>
      </HStack>
      <HStack gap="14" alignItems="stretch">
        <VStack w="32%" padding="18" gap="8" backgroundColor="$positiveSoft" borderRadius="14" border.color="$border" border.width="1" justifyContent="center">
          <Icon name="eye" size="24" color="$positive" alignSelf="start" />
          <Text fontSize="18" color="$positiveText" bold="true">Improved share of visibility</Text>
        </VStack>
        <VStack w="32%" padding="18" gap="8" backgroundColor="$positiveSoft" borderRadius="14" border.color="$border" border.width="1" justifyContent="center">
          <Icon name="zap" size="24" color="$positive" alignSelf="start" />
          <Text fontSize="18" color="$positiveText" bold="true">Higher conversion efficiency</Text>
        </VStack>
      </HStack>
    </VStack>
    <VStack padding="16" gap="4" backgroundColor="$accentSoft" borderLeft.color="$accent" borderLeft.width="5" borderRadius="12" justifyContent="center">
      <Text fontSize="14" color="$accentText" bold="true" letterSpacing="1" textAlign="center">Automation allows brands to react in hours instead of weeks.</Text>
    </VStack>
  </VStack>
</Slide>
